facts.raw_title: Tell HN: Laid off after 11 years — what changed in the market
facts.raw_body: Senior staff eng, kicked out two weeks ago. Recruiters reply but every loop ends in 'we went a different direction'. The market today is not the market in 2022.

judgments.core_claim: 帖子主张 Tell 与 HN 之间存在 显性 关联

risk.rationale: flagged buckets=[]; entities=[]; do_not_engage_hits=[]. 评级规则：do_not_engage 词表命中 = do_not_engage；政治+宗教共现 = high；任一命中 = medium；皆无 = low。

reference_analysis.selection_rationale: 从 4 条里筛 4 条： 1) 排除纯 upvote-bait（高 score 但低 reply 的鼓掌型） 2) 按 reply/upvote 排序选互动密度最高的 top-K 3) 通过 subreddit + 长度做多样性兜底，避免同套路

patterns.name: contrast_setup
patterns.why_it_works: 反转触发认知失调，激发回复欲

patterns.name: data_drop
patterns.description: 丢出一个具体数字制造可信度
patterns.why_it_works: 数字让评论不像情绪发泄、更像内行

patterns.name: self_deprecating
patterns.why_it_works: 把读者拉进来，比单纯的判断更有粘性

patterns.name: rhetorical_question
patterns.description: 提问式评论，把判断让给读者
patterns.why_it_works: 提问比断言更安全，且引导回复

patterns.name: punchy_one_liner
patterns.description: 极简一句话总结，下面接力讨论
patterns.why_it_works: 代言群众情绪，门槛低、转发欲望高
